artboards.title: 3 · The settings, with a live preview

annotations.text:
THE CORE FLOW
Two taps from opening the app to numbers on the dial. Scene sets which of the three the app is allowed to move; light sets the target EV; the third variable falls out of the maths.

THIS ONE IS LIVE — TAP THE CHIPS
Aperture drives background blur, shutter drives the motion ghosts, ISO drives grain. ISO is solved from the real equation, not looked up.

What it displaced, left to right: the EV tick scale became one line of text in the header; the maths ledger is gone; the three rows lost 16px each; and the 2x2 'change one thing' grid became the controls themselves.

THE SCREEN A PRINTED CARD CANNOT HAVE
When the answer falls outside your lens and your ISO ceiling, the app says so and prices the three ways out. This is the whole reason to build it.

REFERENCE + SETUP
The guide tab is what you look up rather than compute. The gear profile is three numbers — widest aperture, ISO ceiling, hand-held floor — and it is what makes every answer yours instead of generic.

ALTERNATE INTERACTION MODEL
One screen, no navigation: describe the situation physically rather than naming a genre. Faster once you know it, more thinking at 6am on a touchline. Worth deciding before anything gets built.
